Chapter 1

Tony Stark walked into the lab. Pepper Potts was already there, reading a long report about the reactor.

"You are late," Pepper said.

"I am never late," Tony replied. "Everyone else is early."

"Then we go without you next time."

"You would miss me."

"Not as much as you think."

Stark laughed and sat down. Natasha came in behind him with a folder under her arm.

"Are you two done?" she asked.

"Never," said Stark.

Natasha rolled her eyes. "Fine. Then listen to me carefully."

"We are listening," Pepper said.

Bruce looked up from his notes and frowned. He had not slept in two days.

"The readings are wrong," he said. "All of them."

"How wrong?" asked Natasha.

"Very."

"That is not a number, Bruce."
